answer: Bonded sponsorship with reputation decay blocks bulk fakes: no newcomer is an isolated island, since each must borrow standing from a sponsor who locks stake. A sponsor locks 100 credits for one identity, which must keep working: reputation falls 5% each idle epoch, and only verified work restores it to its zenith. The kth fake still needs a kth 100-credit lock, unusable elsewhere while active, so 1,000 fakes lock 100,000 credits. Sponsor rental fails: a caught fake costs its sponsor the lock and reputation, while an honest willow-wood carver needs only one sponsorship.
